name: Absorption native scatter official empty slot inventory after completed return

condition.code:
local state=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).GetState()
local tx=state.Transactions['native-product-return-probe']
if not tx or tx.Status~='COMPLETE' then return false end
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Custodian then
  local slot=work.TargetSlot
  local p=Players[slot.Owner]
  local city=p and p:GetCities():FindID(slot.City)
  if not city or city:GetX()~=slot.X or city:GetY()~=slot.Y
    or city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(slot.Building,slot.Slot)~=work.Source.Index then return false end
 end
end
return true

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions['native-product-return-probe'])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','prior native absorption not complete')
local returned,palace
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if snap.Source.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE' then palace=snap
 elseif snap.Custodian and snap.Custodian~=tx.To then returned=snap end
end
assert(returned and palace and returned.PhysicalMoved and palace.PhysicalMoved,'saved original works absent')
local source=A.NativeWorkLocations(returned.Source.Index)
assert(#source==1 and source[1].Owner==returned.Custodian and source[1].CityID==returned.TargetSlot.City,'third-party original work left Palace')
local object=assert(source[1].ObjectType)
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
local human=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(tx.To,object)
local temple=assert(GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_TEMPLE']).Index
local others={}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
 if owner~=tx.To and owner~=returned.Custodian then
  local ok,slots=pcall(reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots,owner,object)
  if ok then for _,slot in ipairs(slots) do if slot.Building==temple and #others<20 then others[#others+1]=slot end end end
 end
end
local free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID and PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()
local count=free and Players[free] and Players[free]:GetCities():GetCount() or -1
local result={ReturnIndex=returned.Source.Index,ReturnOwner=returned.Custodian,
  ReturnSlot=returned.TargetSlot,PalaceIndex=palace.Source.Index,
  HumanEmpty=human,OtherEmptyTemples=others,FreeCityID=free,FreeCityCities=count}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_SCATTER_INVENTORY] '..A.Canonical(result))
return 'scatter fixture observed humanSlots='..#human..' otherTemples='..#others..' freeCities='..count
